U8-G6: the unit lease core lives in src/server/unit-leases.ts and implements the schema-only unit_leases table (0077) as a single atomic upsert claim with holder-fenced heartbeat/release, lazy expiry plus an idempotent sweep, and time as an explicit nowMs input. G5 adds an independent evaluator in src/or-harness/evaluator.ts: cohorts are content-addressed (cohortDigest) and split into fixed deterministic shards with no overlap, replay runs through dispatch on the evaluator own eval:<cohort> ledger without mutating producer records, shard verdicts are sealed with the existing verifier receipt and appended to a hash-chained journal recording receipt lineage, and a HOLD canary rolls the whole evaluation back (staged receipt dropped, later shards never run). Mock/fixture proof only: receipts are synthetic proof mode, no live provider call, no migration added or applied, no server/MCP wiring. The pinned cohort digest gate runs before any replay dispatch or ledger reservation, and shard execution follows the canonical digest order (input array order affects neither digest nor execution).

A successful wrk_ bearer authentication records usage: recordAgentCredentialUse stamps agent_credentials.last_used_at with a 5-minute write window enforced in the UPDATE predicate and returns false without throwing when the 0083 schema has not landed (fail-soft, so authentication never depends on the signal); g5Authenticate records the stamp plus an auth_audit row on wrk_ success only, writing only the non-secret key_id and timestamps. Both signal writes are fail-soft (amended after dots P1 review): the credential decision is made by readAgentCredential before either write, so a failing stamp or auth_audit insert never fails authentication; a failed write is logged by error class only (wrk_usage_stamp_failed / wrk_auth_audit_failed) so the lost signal stays visible. Migration 0083 adds the nullable last_used_at column as a file only and is not applied.

U8-G6 follow-up (dots P1 on PR #29): unit_leases gains a generation fence (0084, file only, not applied). Every successful claim increments generation (takeover or refresh) and returns it on the lease; heartbeatUnitLease and releaseUnitLease require the generation of the caller latest claim, so a stale execution of the same holder id cannot extend or release the lease its successor re-claimed. Holder-only fencing is removed: a restarted holder re-claims to learn the current generation.

U6 fix (dots P2): shadow-report token usage is aggregated per (generation_id, provider, provider_account) — the budget_actuals (0028) unique key — and never summed across providers or accounts. judgments (0078) has no provider column, so a gen_id settled under more than one (provider, provider_account) is counted as usage_ambiguous and excluded from token totals instead of being mixed in. The loader selects provider/provider_account from budget_actuals; GenerationActual carries both as optional fields defaulting to the ledger defaults (openrouter / empty account).
